Hi Jordan —

Following our pilot kickoff, Legal asked us to confirm the roster of downstream data handlers for the telemetry subset used by our analytics pilot. We have a new vendor, ClearSight Analytics, that we expect to turn on for session-level analysis. Before we flip that switch they need confirmation on two items so we can complete our internal DPA addendum:

1) Will ClearSight receive any plain-text PII or exactly which identifiers are passed (hashed ids, full email, IP, etc.)?
2) Which regions will that data traverse/egress through (we need to know if any EU-linked data could leave eu-west-1)?

Attached is BankPlus' standard subprocessor questionnaire for your records. Can you return a completed list or a short notice we can attach to our DPA addendum? Also, are you able to provide a redlined addendum we can sign, or should we propose language?

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround; procurement needs this by EOD next Wednesday.

Emily —

Thanks for the questionnaire — I pulled the relevant items into the attached CSV so you can slot it into your packet. Short answers below followed by proposed language for the addendum.

1) Data types passed to ClearSight:
- We will only forward event telemetry and derived session metrics. Identifiers are hashed session IDs (SHA-256 salted) and client-generated non-reversible IDs. We do NOT forward customer email addresses or raw IP addresses to third-party analytics partners.
- If BankPlus needs IP-based geo-lookup for a feature, that can be performed inside our environment and only aggregated results are forwarded.

2) Egress/regions:
- For BankPlus production workload with EU residency enabled, logs and telemetry remain in eu-west-1. ClearSight will receive data via an encrypted S3 transfer endpoint that we control in eu-west-1.
- We do not route EU-origin production telemetry through US regions. Non-production/test data may be processed from other regions if customers explicitly opt in.

Proposed addendum points (excerpt):
- Purpose limitation: ClearSight may only process telemetry for analytics as specified; no re-identification.
- Residency guarantee: Redwood will ensure exports destined for ClearSight for EU-resident tenants originate from eu-west-1.
- Subprocessor obligations: ClearSight will sign BankPlus' standard DPPA annex and accept audit rights for the pilot period.

I’ve attached a draft addendum (dpa-addendum-draft.docx) with these clauses highlighted. Naomi, please flag any security caveats.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: dpa-addendum-draft.docx
